title: Submission to the Authorities, Fulfilling the Law Through Love

questions.question: Let every person be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:1 (ESV): "Let every person be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been instituted by God."

questions.question: Therefore whoever resists the authorities resists what God has appointed, and those who resist will incur ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:2 (ESV): "Therefore whoever resists the authorities resists what God has appointed, and those who resist will incur judgment."

questions.question: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Would you have no fear of the one who is in authority? Then do what is good, and you will receive his ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:3 (ESV): "For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Would you have no fear of the one who is in authority? Then do what is good, and you will receive his approval,"

questions.question: For he is God's servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not bear the ____ in vain.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:4 (ESV): "for he is God's servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not bear the sword in vain. For he is the servant of God, an avenger who carries out God's wrath on the wrongdoer."

questions.question: Therefore one must be in subjection, not only to avoid God's wrath but also for the sake of ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:5 (ESV): "Therefore one must be in subjection, not only to avoid God's wrath but also for the sake of conscience."

questions.question: For because of this you also pay ____, for the authorities are ministers of God, attending to this very thing.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:6 (ESV): "For because of this you also pay taxes, for the authorities are ministers of God, attending to this very thing."

questions.question: Owe no one anything, except to ____ each other, for the one who loves another has fulfilled the law.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:8 (ESV): "Owe no one anything, except to love each other, for the one who loves another has fulfilled the law."

questions.question: The commandments, "You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not covet," and any other commandment, are summed up in this word: ____.
options: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
"You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart."
"Do unto others as you would have them do unto you."
questions.correctAnswer: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
questions.explanation: Romans 13:9 (ESV): "The commandments... are summed up in this word: 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'"

questions.question: Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore, love is the ____ of the law.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:10 (ESV): "Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore, love is the fulfilling of the law."

questions.question: Besides this you know the time, that the hour has come for you to wake from sleep. For salvation is nearer to us now than when we first ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:11 (ESV): "Besides this you know the time, that the hour has come for you to wake from sleep. For salvation is nearer to us now than when we first believed."

questions.question: The night is far gone; the day is at hand. So then let us cast off the works of darkness and put on the ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:12 (ESV): "The night is far gone; the day is at hand. So then let us cast off the works of darkness and put on the armor of light."

questions.question: Let us walk properly as in the daytime, not in reveling and drunkenness, not in debauchery and sensuality, not in ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:13 (ESV): "Let us walk properly as in the daytime, not in reveling and drunkenness, not in debauchery and sensuality, not in quarreling and jealousy."

questions.question: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:14 (ESV): "But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to gratify its desires."

questions.question: Paul instructs to pay to all what is owed to them: taxes to whom taxes are owed, revenue to whom revenue is owed, respect to whom respect is owed, and ____ to whom it is owed.
questions.explanation: Romans 13:7 (ESV): "Pay to all what is owed to them: taxes to whom taxes are owed, revenue to whom revenue is owed, respect to whom respect is owed, honor to whom honor is owed."

questions.question: In declaring that there is no authority except from God, Paul establishes what view of human government?
options: That all valid human authority is instituted by God's sovereign providence
That human government is an evil necessity that will be abolished
That believers should try to overthrow unjust governments
That the church should rule the state as God's representatives
questions.correctAnswer: That all valid human authority is instituted by God's sovereign providence
questions.explanation: Romans 13:1 (ESV): "For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been instituted by God." This points to God's providential appointment of governing authorities.

key_verse_text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to gratify its desires.
